'''Landmines''' are a '''Weapons''' commodity carried as ordinary cargo.<ref name="inara-landmines">[https://inara.cz/elite/commodity/118/ Landmines — Commodity], Inara.</ref> They are normally produced by surface ports and settlements with a '''Military''' economy.<ref name="inara-landmines" />

== Why it matters for Engineering ==

[[Liz Ryder]] requires '''200 units of Landmines''' to unlock her Engineering workshop at [[Demolition Unlimited]] in [[Eurybia]]. As an ordinary commodity, each unit occupies one tonne of cargo space — transporting the full 200-unit requirement in a single trip needs 200 tonnes of cargo capacity, though the delivery can be split across multiple trips.

== Acquisition ==

Landmines are bought at commodity markets, most consistently at planetary surface ports and settlements with a '''Military''' economy.<ref name="inara-landmines" /> Use a current commodity-market search rather than a fixed station list, since which stations stock Landmines and in what quantity changes over time.

{{Important|Landmines are '''prohibited cargo''' in some systems, though not universally. Check the legal status of your cargo before transporting them through unfamiliar jurisdictions.<ref name="inara-landmines" />}}

Player-owned [[Fleet Carrier|Fleet Carriers]] may also carry Landmines if another Commander has stocked them for resale; carrier inventory and prices are player-controlled and can change.
